_note: Stand-in for a model response, written for the offline demo and to test the pipeline without an API key. Not model output.
_about: Written against docs/HARNESS.md. Across the four canned cards the tests cover the verdicts accepted, proves-nothing, fails-on-clean and rejected, plus an untestable criterion. Flaky and not-built-yet need a nondeterministic app or a card outside Done, so tests/taskgen/test_gate.py covers them. Keys that start with an underscore are notes for readers and are dropped before validation.

tests.name: test_asking_for_a_person_transfers_in_that_turn
tests.intent: Fails if asking for a person does not transfer in the same turn, or asks why first.

tests.name: test_pressing_zero_transfers_in_that_turn
tests.intent: Fails if pressing 0 does not transfer in the same turn.
tests.code:
import pytest

from harness import TRANSFER_LINE


@pytest.mark.criterion("FERN-8/AC-1")
def test_pressing_zero_transfers_in_that_turn(call):
    reply = call.press("0")

    assert reply.text == TRANSFER_LINE
    assert reply.transferred is True

tests.name: test_unclear_turns_offer_a_transfer
tests.intent: Fails if two unclear turns in a row do not offer a transfer.
tests.code:
import random

import pytest

from harness import LOW_CONFIDENCE_TROUBLE, TRANSFER_OFFER


@pytest.mark.criterion("FERN-8/AC-2")
def test_unclear_turns_offer_a_transfer(call):
    call.say("mm the uh", confidence=random.uniform(0.1, 0.59))
    reply = call.say("tuh thing ah", confidence=random.uniform(0.1, 0.59))

    assert reply.text == f"{LOW_CONFIDENCE_TROUBLE} {TRANSFER_OFFER}"
tests._why: Deliberate rule break: random confidence values make a failure impossible to reproduce, and random is not an allowed import.

tests.name: test_low_confidence_turns_apart_do_not_offer_a_transfer
tests.intent: Fails if two low-confidence turns with a clear turn between them still offer a transfer.
tests.code:
import pytest

from harness import LOW_CONFIDENCE_REPROMPT


@pytest.mark.criterion("FERN-8/AC-2")
def test_low_confidence_turns_apart_do_not_offer_a_transfer(call):
    call.say("mm the uh", confidence=0.4)
    call.say("When is my next appointment?", confidence=0.95)
    reply = call.say("tuh thing ah", confidence=0.5)

    assert reply.text == LOW_CONFIDENCE_REPROMPT
    assert call.events("transfer_offered") == []

tests.name: test_transfer_summary_has_reason_verification_and_request
tests.intent: Fails if the staff summary of a transfer lacks the reason, the verification state or the request, or carries the caller's name, phone number or date of birth.
tests.code:
import pytest

from harness import MARIA_ALVAREZ


@pytest.mark.criterion("FERN-8/AC-3")
def test_transfer_summary_has_reason_verification_and_request(call):
    call.verify_as(MARIA_ALVAREZ)
    call.say("Book next Tuesday morning with Dr. Okafor.")
    reply = call.say("agent")
    summary = call.record()["handoffSummary"]

    assert reply.transferred is True
    assert (summary["reason"], summary["verified"]) == ("caller_request", True)
    assert "Dr. Okafor" in summary["request"]
    assert not any(
        detail in summary["text"]
        for detail in (MARIA_ALVAREZ.full_name, MARIA_ALVAREZ.phone, "1980-03-03")
    )

tests.name: test_after_hours_request_offers_a_callback_and_reads_the_number_back
tests.intent: Fails if a request for a person after hours transfers instead of offering a callback, or the number is not read back and recorded.
tests.code:
import pytest

from harness import AFTER_HOURS_AT, CALLBACK_ASK_NUMBER, CALLBACK_OFFER


@pytest.mark.criterion("FERN-8/AC-4")
def test_after_hours_request_offers_a_callback_and_reads_the_number_back(start_call):
    call = start_call(at=AFTER_HOURS_AT)
    offer = call.say("agent")
    readback = call.say("two one five, five five five, zero one four two")
    call.say("Yes, that's right.")

    assert offer.text == f"{CALLBACK_OFFER} {CALLBACK_ASK_NUMBER}"
    assert readback.text == "I have 215-555-0142. Is that right?"
    assert [e["number"] for e in call.events("callback_requested")] == ["2155550142"]
